clinical_indication: Evaluation of recurrent pain in lower right posterior quadrant
findings: Lower right third molar (tooth 48) is horizontally impacted with crown approximating the distal root of tooth 47.
Mild periapical radiolucency associated with the mesial root apex of tooth 36, suggestive of chronic apical periodontitis.
Alveolar bone crest levels are generally within normal limits across both arches.
Bilateral temporomandibular joints appear symmetrical with normal condylar morphology.
impression: 1. Horizontally impacted tooth 48 requiring surgical evaluation. 2. Chronic periapical lesion on tooth 36.
evidence_snippet: Report R101 (OPG, 2026-01-15): Horizontally impacted tooth 48; periapical radiolucency tooth 36.

findings: Developing lower right third molar (tooth 48) with mesioangular inclination.
No evident periapical radiolucency or gross caries noted on visualized dentition.
Normal trabecular bone pattern throughout maxilla and mandible.
impression: Developing third molars without active pathology.
evidence_snippet: Report R102 (OPG, 2025-06-10): Developing mesioangular tooth 48, no periapical pathology.

clinical_indication: Pre-surgical 3D assessment of tooth 48 and relation to inferior alveolar nerve
findings: Tooth 48 roots are in intimate direct contact with the superior cortical border of the right inferior alveolar nerve (IAN) canal.
Cortical thinning and localized breach noted on the lingual cortical plate adjacent to the crown of tooth 48.
No cystic expansion or external root resorption of tooth 47 identified.
impression: High risk of IAN proximity for tooth 48 extraction; lingual cortex fenestration.
evidence_snippet: Report R103 (CBCT, 2026-02-01): Intimate contact between tooth 48 roots and inferior alveolar nerve canal.

clinical_indication: Full mouth periodontal evaluation and bleeding gums
findings: Generalized moderate horizontal alveolar bone loss consistent with chronic generalized periodontitis.
Deep occlusal radiolucency involving enamel and dentin on tooth 16 approaching pulp chamber.
Calculus deposition visible on lingual surfaces of mandibular anterior teeth.
impression: Moderate generalized periodontitis; deep dentinal caries tooth 16.
evidence_snippet: Report R104 (OPG, 2026-03-02): Generalized moderate horizontal bone loss; caries tooth 16.

findings: Well-circumscribed unilocular radiolucency in left posterior mandible extending from distal of tooth 37 into ascending ramus.

impression: Unilocular radiolucent lesion left mandible, differential includes odontogenic keratocyst or ameloblastoma.
evidence_snippet: Report R105 (OPG, 2025-11-12): Well-circumscribed unilocular radiolucency left posterior mandible.

clinical_indication: Volumetric evaluation of left mandibular osteolytic lesion

impression: Expansile osteolytic lesion left mandible with cortical perforation.
evidence_snippet: Report R106 (CBCT, 2025-12-05): 18x12x15mm expansile lesion left mandible with lingual perforation.

clinical_indication: Dental trauma to upper anterior incisors

impression: Subluxation injury of tooth 11 with periapical ligament widening.
evidence_snippet: Report R107 (IOPA, 2026-02-20): Widened periodontal ligament space tooth 11 post-trauma.
